name: Lynn Loud Sr
source:
I'm not as close to my Dad as my sisters are, but don't think for a second that I don't love him, or he doesn't love [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]me[/url]. I know my Dad loves me, and even if we don't have too much in common, I know he's there for me. Now with all that out of the way, I can tell you, just as I'm closest to [url=https://vndb.org/c151352]Mom[/url], my sisters are all closest to Dad.

Dad's a pretty goofy guy who's also way over emotional! He's terrified of Halloween, loves British culture and music, cowbells, Vanzilla and is one of the best cooks in the world!

Dad used to work IT to help take care of the family but his real passion has always been food. We take it for granted that our Dad is a five star chef, but he was recently finally able to achieve his dream and open up a family Restaurant. Dad always tries to make room for all of us too.

I've been told I inherited my dorky side from him, and that girl's love a guy who is genuine and confident in his own skin. At least that's what my Mom and sisters say about my Dad and they all love him, and they say I take after him…so maybe that's a good thing.

[In game description]
